From 580e4273d7a883ececfefa692c1f96bdbacb99b5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Cong Wang <xiyou.wangcong@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2020 12:13:34 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] net_sched: check error pointer in tcf_dump_walker()

Although we take RTNL on dump path, it is possible to
skip RTNL on insertion path. So the following race condition
is possible:

rtnl_lock()		// no rtnl lock
			mutex_lock(&idrinfo->lock);
			// insert ERR_PTR(-EBUSY)
			mutex_unlock(&idrinfo->lock);
tc_dump_action()
rtnl_unlock()

So we have to skip those temporary -EBUSY entries on dump path
too.

Reported-and-tested-by: syzbot+b47bc4f247856fb4d9e1@syzkaller.appspotmail.com
Fixes: 0fedc63fadf0 ("net_sched: commit action insertions together")
Cc: Vlad Buslov <vladbu@mellanox.com>
Cc: Jamal Hadi Salim <jhs@mojatatu.com>
Cc: Jiri Pirko <jiri@resnulli.us>
Signed-off-by: Cong Wang <xiyou.wangcong@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/net/sched/act_api.c b/net/sched/act_api.c
index 5612b336e18e..798430e1a79f 100644
--- a/net/sched/act_api.c
+++ b/net/sched/act_api.c
@@ -235,6 +235,8 @@ static int tcf_dump_walker(struct tcf_idrinfo *idrinfo, struct sk_buff *skb,
 		index++;
 		if (index < s_i)
 			continue;
+		if (IS_ERR(p))
+			continue;

 		    time_after(jiffy_since,

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `net/sched/act_api.c`**
   - Added a check for error pointers in the `tcf_dump_walker` function. Specifically, the following lines were added:
     ```c
     if (IS_ERR(p))
         continue;
     ```
   - This modification ensures that if the pointer `p` is an error pointer (indicated by `IS_ERR(p)`), the function will skip processing that entry and continue to the next iteration.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `net/sched/act_api.c` addresses a potential race condition that can occur during the dumping of actions in the network scheduler. The patch highlights that while the RTNL (Routing Netlink) lock is taken during the dump path, it is possible to bypass it during the insertion path, leading to the insertion of temporary error pointers (specifically `ERR_PTR(-EBUSY)`). By adding the check for error pointers in the `tcf_dump_walker` function, the patch prevents the processing of these temporary error entries during the dump, thereby ensuring the integrity of the dump operation and avoiding potential issues that could arise from handling invalid pointers.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
mutex_lock(&idrinfo->lock);
...
// insert ERR_PTR(-EBUSY)
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the RTNL lock is not held during the insertion of action entries, allowing for the insertion of temporary error pointers (ERR_PTR(-EBUSY)). This can lead to these error pointers being processed during the dump operation, resulting in undefined behavior or crashes.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (IS_ERR(p))
    continue;
```
Reason:
This code statement checks if the pointer `p` is an error pointer using `IS_ERR()`. If it is, the code skips processing that entry, thus preventing the potential undefined behavior or crashes that could occur from processing temporary error pointers during the dump operation.
